svg.title: Cell Tower Lease Buyout Diligence Flow
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-cell-lease-buyout-diligence-flow; chapter number: 1; title: Cell Tower Lease Buyout Diligence Flow; subtitle: Five gates before a landlord accepts a lump sum for the rent stream; caption: Practitioners price a buyout as a multiple of annual rent; tenant mix, lease language and termination risk decide where the multiple lands.; assumptions note: Steps follow the operator gates and pro-tips reported by Tower Genius, Acquisition Insider and Allworth Financial. The rent-stop window of year five to eight and the December/January payment split are as stated by those speakers; no other figures are added.; note: Sources: Acquisition Insider (MtWLazzJb9Y @ 00:06:24, 00:06:38); Tower Genius (X75LHgvP1U8 @ 00:02:04, wpxdOZZukBY @ 00:05:12); Allworth Financial (L5rvTFM0pVg @ 00:06:46).; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Identify Every Carrier on the Tower; value: Step 1; detail: Count every carrier physically on the structure and walk away from single-tenant sites (Acquisition Insider).; step: 02; label: Name Each Sub-Tenant; value: Step 2; detail: Confirm names from meter labels, equipment cabinets and building permits; Dish exposure is toxic to buyers (Tower Genius).; step: 03; label: Clear ROFR and Consent Language; value: Step 3; detail: Read for right of first refusal, confidentiality and consent-to-assign before soliciting offers, or a signed LOI can put the landlord in default (Tower Genius).; step: 04; label: Stress-Test a Rent Stop in Years 5 to 8; value: Step 4; detail: Model the rent stopping in year five to eight; if one site cannot survive that, buy several or pass (Acquisition Insider).; step: 05; label: Shop Bids and Split the Payout; value: Step 5; detail: Push the buyer on price and take half in December and half in January to spread the tax over two years (Allworth Financial).
